# PotionFX

**Category:** Render  
**Aliases:** PotionFX

## What it does

PotionFX draws custom visual effects for potions. Like other effect modules such as JumpEffect and TotemEffect , it is purely cosmetic and does not change how the potions themselves behave.

Description basis: [publisher description](https://liquidbounce.net/docs/modules/render/potionfx). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).
